title: Psychosocial difficulties, Health-Related Quality of life, And Caregiver Burden in Children with Transfusion-Dependent B-Thalassemia
authors: Mir, A., Pervaiz, H., Rehman, A., Hamza, M., Ali, F., Muhammad, J., & Khan, A. A.
summary: Conducted a descriptive cross-sectional study evaluating a clinical sample of 200 child-parent dyads to assess the psychosocial determinants of chronic pediatric diseases. Revealed strong negative correlations between psychosocial difficulties and quality of life, establishing local evidence to advocate for multidisciplinary thalassemia care models.
